messages:
sophie: Heads-up — Prospect 'Petrichor' wants a perf POC next week. Novelty: mixed workload (75 qps gen + 150 qps embeddings) from 2 regions, avg gen ~180 tokens, embeddings are small. p99 gen <350ms, embeddings p99 <120ms. They prefer Private but will accept Dedicated if cost effective. Also submitted a KMS/security questionnaire about per-request decrypts and key rotation. Need runbook + quick hosted vs dedicated cost delta. cc @raj @jules

raj: Mixed workload changes batching and GPU packing. Need exact model ids for both flows and whether embeddings can be routed separately. Also: are they okay with prefix caching for gen?

sophie: Models: gen -> "redwood-llama-large-fp16", embed -> "redwood-embed-small". They want caching on generation but embeddings must be fresh. They flagged concern that KMS might be in the hot path for embeddings (low latency).

jules: Proposed run outline:
- pre-warm: 10m at 20 gen qps + 50 embed qps
- ramp: gen 20->75 over 15m; embed 50->150 over 10m
- soak: 3h mixed steady state (75g + 150e) capturing p50/p90/p95/p99 and token-level cost for gen
- spike: 20m doubling embeds to 300 qps to validate backpressure and routing
- failover: cut primary region (us-central) and measure cold tails in eu-west
Trace sampling 0.5% for full spans and 10% for embeddings (lower payload).

matt: Ops config notes:
- request timeout: gen 8s, embed 2s
- per-worker concurrency: gen 6, embed 40 (small models)
- enable KV prefix cache for gen; disable for embeddings
- set separate autoscale policies per route (embed route scales faster)
- pre-warm models and load KV caches before soak
I'll run the job and capture per-route metrics.

raj: For Private deployment: DEKs cached in runtime; KMS unwrap occurs at DEK rotation / initial load. Embeds path should not trigger per-request KMS unwrapping. Need to show instrumentation to prove it. We'll run a smoke that tags requests with kms-cache-hit header.

security-bot: Questionnaire logged: https://redwood-internal/q/PTR-2026-KMS. Required answers: envelope flow, DEK cache TTL, per-request KMS frequency, audit logs, HSM option, and proof of non-blocking unwrap.

matt: Quick smoke commands:
```bash
# Vegeta burst for embeddings
printf '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood/v1/embed","body":"$(cat embed_payload.json)"}' | vegeta attack -rate=150 -duration=30s | vegeta report -type=json > vegeta-embed-150.json

# k6 for gen workload
k6 run --vus 30 --duration 3h --rps 75 gen_mix.js
```
I'll include headers: x-model, x-seq-len, x-kms-cache to help trace.

finance-bot: Very rough cost delta: Hosted mixed (qps above) estimated ~$780/day for test window (includes extra embedding infra). Dedicated (pro-rated, small cluster) estimate ~$260/day + ~0.01$/KMS-unlock if they choose HSM-backed KMS (requires sizing). Final after exact GPU-hours and KMS call count.

sophie: Can we give a short KMS explainer they can paste into questionnaire that says DEK caching avoids per-request unwraps and gives a timeline for rotation? They want plain language + a small sequence list.

jules: Draft plain-language answer: "In Private/Dedicated deployments we use envelope encryption. The workload uses a data encryption key (DEK) to encrypt payloads. The KMS is only invoked to unwrap/wrap DEKs at key generation or rotation; DEKs are cached in the serving runtime with configurable TTL (default 6h). Runtime does not call KMS per inference. We can enable HSM-backed KMS and provide audit logs on every unwrap operation." I'll format and attach a tiny diagram for them.

matt: I'll add a tiny perf-proof: run the embed-only smoke and show that x-kms-cache:true on >99.9% of requests in the soak. Also capture any KMS-unwrap spans if rotation triggered.

ops-bot: Tentative run scheduled: 2026-05-04T09:00:00Z run id ptr-poc-525 (assigned to matt).

sophie: Please post the final runbook, cost stub, and the short KMS explainer by EOD so I can send to Petrichor procurement.

raj: Will post model placement/sizing and perf caveats by 17:00 PT.

jules: I'll attach the one-pager and tiny diagram by EOD.

matt: Confirmed. I'll add the k6/vegeta snippets and a small script to flag any KMS unwraps during key rotation.
